sourceArticle.title: How to Build a Claude Code-Powered Knowledge Base
sourceArticle.author: Eivind Kjosbakken

athenaOutput.directive: The Creative Liberation Engine shall develop a sovereign, self-hosted, and perpetually evolving LLM-powered knowledge base to enhance agent efficiency and information retrieval, strictly adhering to Article I: Sovereignty by leveraging our own OpenCode capabilities rather than external proprietary solutions like Claude Code.
athenaOutput.rationale: The provided article discusses building a 'Claude Code-Powered Knowledge Base.' However, the Creative Liberation Engine's foundational principles, as established in prior ATHENA directives (e.g., 'EP214: Claude Code vs. OpenClaw: 5 Design Dimensions', 'OpenCode | The open source AI coding agent', and 'The Hidden Google AI Tools You Probably Aren't Using Yet'), explicitly prioritize the development of sovereign, self-hosted AI solutions and our own OpenCode agent. Utilizing an external, proprietary tool like Claude Code for a core component such as a knowledge base directly violates Article I: Sovereignty. While the concept of an LLM-powered knowledge base for efficient data retrieval is highly valuable and aligns with our goals, the specific implementation using 'Claude Code' is fundamentally redundant and unconstitutional. Therefore, this specific topic, as framed, is to be discarded.
